description: Stadtwerke Lehrte Gas, Wasser, Strom Versorgungsnetze is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by stadtwerke-lehrte.de. The Stadtwerke Lehrte operate the natural gas network of the city Lehrte and its districts as well as the district Ilten of the city of Sehnde. Drinking water is supplied to the core city of Lehrte. The power grid is operated in the city of Lehrte as well as its districts. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Municipal utilities Educational gas, water, electricity Supply grids" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Stromversorgung, inspireidentifiziert. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
